reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the known effect of W addition from Fe-P-C-B amorphous alloys (P31, P43) to the CrMnFeCoNiP high-entropy alloy system, using the same mechanism (atomic size mismatch, cohesive energy, diffusion hindrance) and predicting the same outcome (higher Tx, wider ΔTx). It does not combine findings from different papers, propose a new mechanism, or resolve a conflict; it is a straightforward extrapolation of a single prior result to a new composition.
